description: Five reference books deployed to the IBKR paper account. They are NOT alpha claims -- they exist so any future strategy is measured against what you earn with zero skill, through the identical cost, fill and accounting path. B2 (duration-hedged HY carry), B7 (naive pair z-score) and B8 (naive raw premium/discount) require SHORT legs, which static_weights forbids, so those three continue as shadow books in results/bench/ rather than live orders.

limits._suspend_note: Effectively disabled 2026-07-31 on standing instruction: paper deployment exists to generate data and a suspended book stops producing it. Drawdown is reported in the daily log for human review. Broker margin limits still apply and are not ours to disable.
